To update, read `dist.tarball` and `dist.integrity` from `https://registry.npmjs.org/vue/<version>`, download the tarball into an empty directory, check its sha512 against `dist.integrity`, extract it, replace both files, update the version and the two hashes here and the version in `dashboard/README.md`, and run the dashboard once in a browser.
